items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: He was a la Bix Bates.

ctx.x: Trumpet. He was a la Bix Bates. He didn't go too high, he didn't go too high, he was right in the middle, but he was fantastic. But then we had to wear funny hats and all that crap.
What kind of a book did you have, you said, it wasn't Dixieland.
